name: Grappling Stance and Motion
description: Keep head over hips, elbows close, lead leg protected, and move without crossing the feet.

name: Backward Breakfall
description: Tuck the chin, round the back, slap at a safe angle, and keep the head from striking the mat.

name: Side Breakfall
description: Land on the lat and side rather than the elbow; keep the chin tucked and legs organized.

name: Forward Shoulder Roll
description: Roll diagonally from shoulder to opposite hip with a rounded spine and a protected head.

name: Technical Stand-Up
description: Post one hand behind, keep the near shin as a shield, lift the hips, retract the far leg, and regain stance.

name: Hand Fighting for Inside Position
description: Win wrist, biceps, and inside-elbow position while keeping posture and denying clean entries.

name: Lapel-and-Sleeve Grip Fighting
description: Establish a useful lapel-and-sleeve pair, break dominant grips, and keep the elbows connected before attacking.

name: Standing Underhook Pummel
description: Circle the arms inside without flaring, connect forehead position, and recover one or two underhooks.

name: Collar Tie with Elbow Control
description: Pull through the crown rather than the neck, control the far elbow, and keep the tying elbow down.

name: Russian Tie Two-on-One
description: Pin one wrist and connect the second arm above the elbow to turn the opponent and expose a side angle.

name: Standing Arm Drag
description: Pull the wrist past while steering above the elbow, step to the outside, and connect to the waist or rear body lock.

name: Duck-Under
description: Lift or steer the elbow, change level, pass the head beneath the arm, and circle tight to the back.

name: Throw-By
description: Use the collar tie and triceps to shuck the shoulder past while circling to the exposed back.

name: Snapdown to Front Headlock
description: Move the feet, pull crown and elbow toward the mat, sprawl the hips back, and connect chin strap plus arm control.

name: Front Headlock Go-Behind
description: Block the near arm, keep chest pressure over the shoulders, circle behind the elbows, and secure the hips.

name: Double-Leg Takedown
description: Change level, penetrate with head and spine aligned, connect behind the knees, turn the corner, and finish past the legs.

name: Blast Double-Leg
description: Enter through the center with upright posture, drive across the hips, and keep the head from dropping outside.

name: Double-Leg Corner Finish
description: After connecting to both legs, step the outside foot around, steer the knees sideways, and cover the hips.

name: High-Crotch Entry
description: Penetrate between the legs with inside head position, clamp high on the thigh, and rise to a safe finish.

name: Outside Single-Leg
description: Step to the outside, connect above the knee with head inside, and keep the captured leg tight to the body.

name: Inside Single-Leg
description: Collect the near leg with head outside but posture strong, immediately turn the corner, and avoid lingering in guillotine range.

name: Run-the-Pipe Single-Leg Finish
description: Shelf the leg, circle toward the captured foot, rotate the knee line, and cover without falling into guard.

name: Tree-Top Single-Leg Finish
description: Lift the ankle high while pinching the knee, off-balance with shoulder pressure, and trip or mat-return safely.

name: Single-Leg Inside-Trip Finish
description: From a tight elevated single, step between the feet, reap the support leg lightly, and guide the descent.

name: Crackdown Single-Leg Finish
description: When forced outside and low, shelf the thigh, control the far hip, and circle or limp-leg to top position.

name: Low Single-Leg
description: Level-change to the lead ankle, shoulder the shin, catch the heel, and drive at an angle before the sprawl settles.

name: Ankle Pick
description: Use upper-body control to load weight over one foot, block that ankle, and drive or circle the torso over it.

name: Knee Pick
description: Secure an underhook or body connection, block behind the far knee, and steer the upper body across the trapped leg.

name: Body-Lock Outside Trip
description: Lock around the torso, step outside the near leg, block the heel line, and turn chest-to-chest into top control.

name: Body-Lock Inside Trip
description: Off-balance with a tight body lock, step inside the support leg, reap while steering the shoulders, and land past guard.

name: Rear Body-Lock Mat Return
description: Lower the lock to the hips, block a side, lift only as needed, and return the opponent under control without spiking.

name: Tight-Waist Trip Mat Return
description: Keep a tight waist, block the near knee or ankle, and guide the opponent to a hip while staying behind the elbows.

name: De Ashi Barai
description: Time the light advancing foot, sweep at the ankle, and steer the lapel-and-sleeve grips in the same direction.

name: Sasae Tsurikomi Ashi
description: Block the ankle as the opponent steps, lift and turn the upper body, and rotate them over the prop.

name: Ko Uchi Gari
description: Drive weight onto one heel, reap the inside of that ankle, and follow into a stable passing stance.

name: O Uchi Gari
description: Step deep between the feet, reap the weighted leg in a circle, and keep posture tall enough to avoid a guillotine.

name: O Soto Gari
description: Break balance to the rear corner, step beside the support foot, reap the far leg, and control the landing.

name: Ko Soto Gake
description: Pin the near foot with an outside hook while steering the torso over the trapped heel.

name: Uchi Mata
description: Turn the hips while lifting the inner thigh and steering the upper body; follow through to avoid conceding the back.

name: Harai Goshi
description: Load the opponent onto the hip line, sweep the outside leg, and rotate the shoulders through a controlled finish.

name: O Goshi
description: Secure the waist, place the hips below and across, straighten the legs, and rotate the opponent over the hip shelf.

name: Koshi Guruma
description: Wrap high around the head-and-arm line, turn the hips across, and wheel the opponent while protecting your own back.

name: Ippon Seoi Nage
description: Control one arm, turn beneath the shoulder with hips low, fit tightly, and project while keeping the elbow captured.

name: Drop Seoi Nage
description: Drop under a strongly loaded sleeve and lapel, keep the knees aligned, and rotate through without exposing the back unnecessarily.

name: Tai Otoshi
description: Create forward-corner imbalance, turn in, extend the blocking leg without locking the knee, and steer over the barrier.

name: Kata Guruma
description: Control the arm, enter under the center of mass, capture the leg, and rotate to a covered finish rather than exposing the neck.

name: Fireman's Carry Dump
description: From arm control, enter to the far leg, pull the arm across, and dump toward the trapped-arm side into top position.

name: Standing Sumi Gaeshi
description: Control the upper body, sit beneath the center, lift the inner thigh with a hook, and roll to a stable top position.

name: Tomoe Nage
description: Pull the opponent forward, sit close, place a foot at the belt or hip, and extend while steering to land on top.

name: Tani Otoshi
description: From a rear or side angle, sit behind both heels and guide the torso backward; never jump laterally into the knee.

name: Yoko Otoshi
description: Create a strong sideward off-balance, sit outside the foot line, and rotate the opponent across the extended leg.

name: Lateral Drop
description: With over-under control and forward pressure received, step across, arch only enough to rotate, and land chest-to-chest.

name: Standing Guillotine
description: Wrap the neck during a level change, connect the hands, lift posture, and finish only with controlled alignment.

name: Standing Kimura Trap
description: Figure-four the attacking arm, rotate the elbow line, and use the grip to turn, sweep, or expose the back.

name: Sprawl Defense
description: Throw the hips back and heavy over the shoulders, frame or crossface, widen the feet, and circle off the head.

name: Whizzer Single-Leg Defense
description: Drive a heavy overhook, square the hips, fight head position, and free the knee before attacking a trip or front headlock.

name: Crossface Single-Leg Defense
description: Frame across the face or shoulder line, turn the head away, sprawl the captured hip, and circle the leg free.

name: Closed-Guard Pull
description: Secure upper-body grips, place a controlling foot or sit with posture, connect closed guard, and avoid hanging from the knees.

name: Seated-Guard Pull
description: Make contact first, lower to a hip with frames intact, and connect to shin-to-shin, butterfly, or a sleeve guard.

name: De La Riva Guard Pull
description: Control sleeve and collar or ankle, sit under the lead leg, establish the outside hook, and manage distance immediately.

name: Single-Leg X Guard Pull
description: Use a controlled foot-on-hip or shin connection, sit beneath the lead leg, and close the ashi frame without falling loose.

name: Closed-Guard Posture Control
description: Keep knees active, pull the upper body off its base, control an arm or head, and angle the hips before attacking.

name: Closed-Guard Angle Change
description: Use a foot on the mat or hip movement to place the torso off-center while keeping the opponent's posture controlled.

name: Closed-Guard Overhook Control
description: Overhook one arm, keep the shoulder forward, control the far side, and use the angle for chokes, triangles, or omoplatas.

name: Closed-Guard Underhook Back Take
description: Win a deep underhook, climb the guard high, move the head past the shoulder, and use a hip angle to expose the back.

name: Closed-Guard Arm-Drag Back Take
description: Pin the wrist, drag above the elbow across center, sit to the outside hip, and climb behind the shoulder.

name: Armbar from Closed Guard
description: Control wrist and elbow, break posture, pivot across the shoulder, clamp the knees, and extend the hips through the elbow line.

name: Triangle Choke from Closed Guard
description: Isolate one arm, place one leg over the neck, lock behind the knee, cut an angle, and compress knees plus hamstring.

name: Kimura from Closed Guard
description: Sit up when a hand posts, secure wrist and figure-four, turn the elbow, and angle the hips before finishing.

name: Guillotine from Closed Guard
description: Wrap the neck during low posture, control chin line, close distance, and finish with the ribs and hips rather than pulling only with the arms.

name: Omoplata from Closed Guard
description: Control one arm, pivot the hips, thread the leg over the shoulder, sit up, control the waist, and bring the knees forward.

name: Cross-Collar Choke from Closed Guard
description: Set the first grip deep at the label, cross the second hand, angle the wrists to the neck, and draw elbows toward the ribs.

name: Loop Choke from Closed Guard
description: Feed a cross collar grip, loop the forearm around the neck as posture drives in, trap the head, and turn the elbow line.

name: Overhook Lapel Choke from Closed Guard
description: Use an overhook to trap the shoulder, feed the lapel or collar across the neck, and close the space while angling the hips.

name: Ezekiel Choke from Closed Guard Bottom
description: Thread one sleeve grip behind the neck, place the other forearm across the throat line, and compress while controlling posture.

name: Hip-Bump Sweep
description: Open the guard as posture rises, sit to one hand, trap the far posting arm, and drive the hips diagonally over the shoulder.

name: Scissor Sweep
description: Open to a shin frame, pull the opponent over the hips, chop the far knee, and steer the upper body across the sweep.

name: Knee-Push Sweep
description: From a scissor frame, place the lower foot at the far knee, push it away, and rotate the upper body to the mat.

name: Pendulum Sweep
description: Control an arm and underhook the far leg, swing the free leg as a pendulum, lift the hip, and rotate into mount.

name: Flower Sweep
description: Control sleeve and pant or leg, open to an angle, swing the free leg, and rotate the opponent toward the trapped arm.

name: Lumberjack Sweep
description: When the opponent stands, open the guard, cup both ankles, drive the knees toward the chest, and follow up before they recover base.

name: Muscle Sweep
description: Underhook a leg or hip, sit underneath the center, lift with the knees, and steer the upper body toward the trapped side.

name: Two-on-One Sweep from Closed Guard
description: Use two-on-one arm control to turn the shoulder, sit to the outside, block the base, and roll through to top.

name: Hip-Bump to Triangle
description: Threaten the hip bump, guide the posting arm between the legs, and lock the triangle as the opponent drives back in.

name: Hip-Bump to Kimura
description: Sit up for the sweep, capture the far posting wrist, connect the figure-four, and angle away before finishing.

name: Armbar–Triangle–Omoplata Chain
description: Follow defensive elbow movement from armbar to triangle and then shoulder line, maintaining posture control throughout the transitions.

name: Williams Guard Control
description: Overhook an arm, bring the same-side knee high over the shoulder, connect to the far side, and pin posture for attacks.

name: Rubber Guard Mission Control
description: Break posture, overhook, bring a shin high across the upper back, and control the ankle without forcing knee flexibility.

name: Rubber Guard to Omoplata
description: From high overhook control, clear the trapped arm, rotate the shin over the shoulder, and sit up into omoplata control.

name: Shoulder-Crunch Sweep from Closed Guard
description: Clamp the shoulder with both arms, place the elbow above the shoulder line, open to a butterfly hook, and elevate diagonally.

name: Choi Bar from Closed Guard
description: Clamp an underhooked shoulder, slide the knee over the trapped arm, connect heel to hip, and extend the elbow with tight shoulder control.

name: Hip-Escape Guard Recovery
description: Frame at shoulder and hip, move the hips away, insert the near knee, and rebuild two meaningful frames.

name: Reverse Hip-Escape Guard Recovery
description: Frame the passer, move the shoulders away, bring the hips inward, and recover the far knee or a hook.

name: Elbow–Knee Connection Retention
description: Keep elbows and knees linked inside the passer's arms so the legs can pummel without exposing the torso.

name: Foot-Pummel Guard Retention
description: Circle the feet back inside the passer's arms, reconnect soles or shins to useful frames, and keep the hips mobile.

name: High-Leg Guard Recovery
description: Frame the upper body, swing the near leg high over the shoulder line, and replace a knee shield or hook before the crossface settles.

name: Granby Guard Recovery
description: Roll across the shoulders while keeping the neck free, bring the knees between bodies, and finish facing the passer.

name: Inversion Guard Retention
description: Rotate across the shoulders, keep weight off the neck, follow the passer with hip rotation, and recover the inside knee line.

name: Sit-Up Guard Recovery
description: When distance opens, post safely, square the hips, recover seated hand-fighting position, and deny free ankle control.

name: Turtle Sit-Out to Guard
description: Control the near arm, sit the hips through the open side, face the opponent, and insert frames before extending away.

name: Turtle Granby to Guard
description: Protect the neck, roll across the near shoulder under the opponent's control, and thread the legs back between bodies.

name: Seated-Guard Hand Fighting
description: Keep head and knees forward, win wrist or ankle contact, hand-fight inside, and avoid posting both hands behind.

name: Butterfly Guard Double-Underhooks
description: Sit close with both insteps inside, connect underhooks, keep the forehead engaged, and move beneath the opponent's base.

name: Basic Butterfly Sweep
description: Control an arm and upper body, fall to the shoulder rather than the back, lift with the inside hook, and steer diagonally.

name: Overhook Butterfly Sweep
description: Use an overhook and far wrist, shift under the trapped shoulder, elevate with the same-side hook, and rotate to top.

name: Underhook Butterfly Sweep
description: Secure a deep underhook, block the far arm, bring the hips close, and elevate toward the opponent's missing post.

name: Butterfly Elevator Sweep
description: Load the opponent over both hooks, extend one or both legs while steering the upper body, and follow the arc into top position.

name: Shoulder-Crunch Butterfly Sweep
description: Clamp one shoulder with the elbow elevated, shift under that side, and use the butterfly hook to tip the compressed upper body.

name: Butterfly Arm-Drag Back Take
description: Pin a wrist, drag the elbow past, scoot to the outside hip, and use a hook plus waist grip to climb behind.

name: Butterfly Snapdown to Front Headlock
description: As the passer leans forward, pull crown and elbow past your shoulder, rise to the knees, and secure front headlock position.

name: Butterfly Guard to Single-Leg X
description: Elevate one knee, scoot underneath, wrap the outside leg around the hip, and connect the inside foot to the thigh.

name: Butterfly Guard to X Guard
description: Elevate the near leg, enter beneath the hips, place one hook at the far hip and one behind the near knee, and control posture.

name: Guillotine from Butterfly Guard
description: Snap the head into a chin strap, connect the grip, use a hook or closed leg position to manage distance, and finish with side crunch.

name: Butterfly Front-Headlock Wrestle-Up
description: Snap the passer to hands, rise behind the elbows, circle to the hip, and secure top control as they recover posture.

name: Butterfly Knee-Tap Wrestle-Up
description: Win an underhook, come to one knee, block the far knee, and drive the upper body across it into top position.

name: Butterfly Dummy Sweep
description: When the passer stands square, connect both insteps at the shins, pull the ankles, extend the hooks, and rise into a pass.

name: Butterfly Technical Stand-Up
description: Create distance with a shin or hand frame, post one hand, retract the far leg, and stand without exposing the back.

name: Shin-to-Shin Guard Control
description: Wrap the near leg, connect shin to shin, keep the knee pointed inside, and control the ankle or upper body.

name: Shin-to-Shin to Single-Leg X
description: Pull the knee forward, scoot under the hip, thread the outside leg around the waist, and establish the ashi frame.

name: Shin-to-Shin Wrestle-Up
description: Control the ankle, rise to the knees behind the leg, keep the head inside, and finish as a single-leg takedown.

name: Shin-to-Shin Knee-Tap Sweep
description: Pull the upper body forward, block the far knee, drive through the near leg, and come up into passing position.

name: Sit-Up Guard Single-Leg
description: Sit behind the lead shin, control knee and ankle, rise with head inside, and connect to a single-leg finish.

name: Sit-Up Guard Knee Pick
description: Use an upper-body tie and near-leg connection, block the far knee, and drive diagonally to top position.

name: Sit-Up Guard Arm Drag
description: Drag the arm across, post on the far hip, rise behind the shoulder, and connect to the back or rear body lock.

name: Sit-Up Guard Ankle Pick
description: Control the upper body, pull weight over the lead foot, block the ankle, and drive the torso beyond the base.

name: Single-Leg X Control
description: Clamp one leg with an outside hip frame and inside thigh connection, hide the feet, and keep the captured knee line centered.

name: Single-Leg X Outside Sweep
description: Control the ankle, turn both knees toward the outside, extend the hip frame, and follow the opponent's fall to top.

name: Single-Leg X Inside Sweep
description: Pull the captured leg inward, lift the hip with the outside foot, and steer the knee across the opponent's base.

name: Single-Leg X Technical Stand-Up
description: Off-balance the opponent, retract the outside leg, rise while keeping the ankle, and finish the single before passing.

name: Single-Leg X to X Guard
description: When the opponent turns the knee outward, swim the inside leg across to the far hip and place the second hook behind the near knee.

name: Single-Leg X to Reverse X
description: Invert or rotate beneath the captured leg, switch hip frames, and position the knees to expose the far hip or saddle entry.

name: X-Guard Control
description: Stay beneath the hips with one foot at the far hip and one behind the near knee, keeping the captured leg on the shoulder.

name: X-Guard Back Sweep
description: Extend the far-hip hook while pulling the near leg, tip the opponent backward, and follow the leg to top position.

name: X-Guard Side Sweep
description: Stretch the opponent diagonally, steer the captured knee across, and tip them over the weak side before coming up.

name: X-Guard Technical Stand-Up
description: Extend the opponent away, remove the lower hook, rise while keeping the leg elevated, and finish a single-leg or ankle pick.

name: X-Guard Back Take
aliases: X guard to rear body lock
description: Turn the captured knee away, rotate behind the hips, and use the hooks to expose a rear body-lock or crab-ride angle.

name: X-Guard Sweep to Leg Drag
aliases: X guard technical stand to drag
description: Off-balance forward, come up controlling both legs, direct the knees across, and settle chest-to-hip in leg-drag position.

name: De La Riva Guard Control
description: Wrap an outside hook around the lead leg, control ankle plus upper body, and use the free foot to manage distance and angle.

name: De La Riva Tripod Sweep
description: Control sleeve and ankle, place the free foot at the far hip or knee, extend the upper body, and block the heel line.

name: De La Riva Sickle Sweep
description: Extend the hip with one foot, hook behind the far heel with the other, and steer the sleeve toward the blocked side.

name: De La Riva Single-Leg Wrestle-Up
description: Control the lead ankle, sit behind the leg as it withdraws, rise with head inside, and finish the single-leg.

name: De La Riva Berimbolo
description: Off-balance the opponent to a seated hip, invert beneath the belt line, control the far hip, and climb to the back.

name: De La Riva Baby Bolo
description: From a shallow off-balance, sit up to the far hip, clamp the waist, and insert the near hook without a full inversion.

name: De La Riva Matrix Entry
description: Thread the free leg behind the far thigh, invert under the near leg, and use sleeve or belt control to climb to the back.

name: De La Riva Tomoe Sweep
description: Pull the upper body forward, place the free foot at the hip, lift the center while steering the sleeve, and follow to top.

name: Reverse De La Riva Control
description: Hook the lead leg from inside, frame the far hip or shoulder, control the ankle, and keep the knee line between bodies.

name: Reverse De La Riva Kiss of the Dragon
description: Invert beneath the lead leg, rotate around the trapped thigh, connect behind the hips, and climb to the back.

name: Reverse De La Riva Tripod Sweep
description: Control the lead ankle, frame the far hip, extend the hook while blocking the base, and come up into passing position.

name: Reverse De La Riva to Single-Leg X
description: Use the inside hook to lift the lead leg, scoot underneath, and switch the outside leg around the hip into straight ashi.

name: Reverse De La Riva Inversion Recovery
description: Follow the knee cut by rotating across the shoulders, keep the hook connected, and recover facing position or an under-leg entry.

name: Collar-and-Sleeve Guard Control
description: Use a cross collar grip, same-side sleeve control, one foot at the hip, and the other leg to frame or hook.

name: Collar-Sleeve Tripod Sweep
description: Control sleeve and collar, block the near ankle, extend the far hip, and steer the upper body beyond the base.

name: Collar-Sleeve Sickle Sweep
description: Push at the hip, hook behind the far heel, and pull collar and sleeve toward the blocked direction.

name: Armbar from Collar-Sleeve Guard
description: Control the sleeve, pull the shoulder over the hips, pivot the far leg over the head, and clamp the elbow line.

name: Triangle from Collar-Sleeve Guard
description: Pull the controlled sleeve across, shoot the hip-frame leg over the neck, lock behind the knee, and cut the finishing angle.

name: Omoplata from Collar-Sleeve Guard
description: Pin the sleeve, pivot the hip-frame leg over the shoulder, control the waist, and sit up before finishing.

name: Collar-Sleeve Back Take
description: Drag the controlled sleeve across, sit toward the exposed shoulder, use the collar to keep rotation, and insert hooks.

name: Spider Guard Control
description: Control both sleeves, place the soles at the biceps, alternate extension and retraction, and keep knees tracking safely.

name: Spider Guard Tripod Sweep
description: Extend one biceps, hook or block the opposite ankle, and pull the other sleeve across the weak corner.

name: Spider Guard Omoplata
description: Extend one arm, pull the opposite sleeve across, pivot under the extended shoulder, and sit up with waist control.

name: Spider Guard Triangle
description: Pull one arm across while extending the other, shoot a leg over the neck, lock the triangle, and cut the angle.

name: Lasso Guard Control
description: Wrap the leg outside and under the controlled arm, keep the knee active, and manage the far sleeve or collar.

name: Lasso Guard Sweep
description: Pull the lassoed shoulder forward, block the far base, elevate with the shin, and steer the opponent over the trapped arm.

name: Lasso Guard Single-Leg Sweep
description: Keep the lasso sleeve, sit up around the lead leg, rise to a single, and use the trapped arm to finish safely.

name: Lasso Guard Omoplata
description: Extend the lassoed arm, rotate the leg over the shoulder, free the knee line, and sit up controlling the waist.

name: Double-Sleeve Guard Sweep
description: Control both sleeves, place feet at hips or biceps, load the passer over the hips, and steer them past their posts.

name: Worm Guard Control
description: Feed the opponent's lapel around the lead leg, pass it under your thigh, and use the wrap to control hip rotation.

name: Worm Guard Sweep
description: Tension the lapel around the leg, block the far base, extend the free leg, and rotate the opponent over the trapped hip.

name: Worm Guard Back Take
description: Use the lapel wrap to turn the lead knee inward, circle behind the hips, and climb from a crab-ride or belt-control angle.

name: Squid Guard Control
description: Feed a lapel under the opponent's leg to the far hand, angle the hips outside, and keep shoulder plus knee tension connected.

name: Squid Guard Sweep
description: Use the lapel to pull the far hip across, block the near foot, and rotate under the center into top position.

name: Lapel Single-Leg Wrestle-Up
description: Wrap or feed the lapel around the lead leg, rise behind the knee, and use the tether to finish the single safely.

name: K Guard Control
description: Clamp one leg with the near knee inside and far leg over the hip, control the far leg, and keep the opponent's knee line exposed.

name: K Guard Entry from Closed Guard
description: Underhook a leg as the opponent rises, open to the side, thread the near knee inside, and connect the far leg over the hip.

name: K Guard Entry from Half Butterfly
description: Use the butterfly hook to lift the near knee, underhook the far leg, rotate beneath the hips, and connect K guard.

name: K Guard to Backside 50/50
description: Rotate under the captured leg, thread the outside knee behind the hip, and close 50/50 from the backside angle.

name: K Guard Matrix Back Take
description: Thread the far leg behind the thigh, invert beneath the captured knee, and climb along the hip line to the back.

name: K Guard Wrestle-Up
description: Use the leg underhook to turn the knee, come onto the elbow and knee, and rise while keeping the captured leg.

name: Waiter Guard Control
description: Sit beneath the opponent with the near leg carried on the shoulder, control the far hip, and keep the knees between bodies.

name: Waiter Sweep
description: Elevate the carried leg, block the far base, rotate the hips underneath, and follow the opponent to top position.

name: Waiter Guard Back Take
description: Turn the captured knee away, sit behind the hips, connect a crab-ride hook, and climb to the waist.

name: 50/50 Guard Control
description: Entangle one leg with mirrored inside position, control the knee line, hide the feet, and win upper-body or ankle grips.

name: 50/50 Technical Stand-Up Sweep
description: Off-balance the opponent backward, post safely, rise while controlling the trapped leg, and finish in a passing stance.

name: 50/50 Back Take
description: Turn the opponent's knee away, expose the far hip, rotate behind the belt line, and connect to crab ride or rear waist control.

name: Backside 50/50 Control
description: Control the trapped knee from behind the hip line, keep your knees tight, hide the feet, and manage the far leg.

name: Crab-Ride Control
description: Place both feet behind the opponent's knees or hips, control the belt line, and steer hip rotation without crossing the feet loosely.

name: Crab-Ride Back Take
description: Extend one hip, pull the opposite waist, insert the near hook, and climb chest-to-back before securing the second hook.

name: Baby Bolo to Mount
description: When the opponent squares away from the back take, lift the far hip, steer the knees aside, and slide directly into mount.

name: Matrix Back Take
description: Thread the leg behind the far thigh, invert under the near leg, control sleeve or belt, and climb along the hip to the back.

name: Half-Guard Frame Survival
description: Keep the outside knee and forearm inside, deny crossface and underhook, stay on a side, and control the trapped leg.

name: Knee-Shield Half Guard
description: Place the top shin across the torso, connect elbow to knee, frame the shoulder, and keep the bottom knee controlling the trapped leg.

name: High Knee-Shield Recovery
description: Drive the top knee toward the shoulder, frame the far arm, create hip space, and recover full guard or an underhook.

name: Low Knee-Shield Underhook Entry
description: Lower the shield to the hip, guide the crossface arm away, swim a deep underhook, and come onto the side.

name: Half-Guard Underhook to Dogfight
description: Win the underhook, place the head under the chin, come to the elbow and knee, and clamp the trapped leg before rising.

name: Dogfight Knee-Tap Sweep
description: From the underhook rise, block the far knee, drive the shoulder across, and free the trapped leg as the opponent falls.

name: Old-School Sweep
description: Reach under to the far foot, draw it toward the hips, block the near base, and drive forward into top position.

name: Plan B Sweep
description: When the whizzer drives forward, sit the hips under, trap the posting arm or leg, and roll the opponent over the near shoulder.

name: Dogfight Limp-Arm Back Take
description: Use forward pressure to slip the underhooked arm behind the whizzer, circle to the rear waist, and free the trapped leg.

name: Half-Guard Waist-Lock Back Take
description: Climb the underhook to a waist lock, move the head behind the shoulder, and rotate under the hips to expose the back.

name: John Wayne Sweep
description: Clamp the trapped leg, bridge the knees toward the inside to force a post, and reverse direction as the opponent reacts.

name: Half-Guard Kimura Sweep
description: Capture the posting wrist, connect the figure-four, use the knee shield to turn the shoulders, and roll or sit up to top.

name: Half-Guard Kimura Back Take
description: Maintain the figure-four as the opponent turns, free the knees, follow the far hip, and climb behind the shoulder.

name: Guillotine from Half Guard
description: Use the knee shield to create neck access, secure a chin strap, close the elbow, and control the far hip before finishing.

name: Loop Choke from Half Guard
description: Feed a cross-collar grip, loop the forearm as the opponent pressures in, trap the head, and rotate beneath the choking elbow.

name: Half-Butterfly Guard Control
description: Control one leg in half guard while placing the inside foot as a butterfly hook, framing the upper body and staying on a side.

name: Half-Butterfly Sweep
description: Secure upper-body control, elevate the near thigh with the hook, turn to the shoulder, and guide the opponent over the missing post.

name: Half Butterfly to X Guard
description: Lift the near knee with the hook, swim beneath the hips, place the far-hip foot, and convert the lower leg to the knee hook.

name: Half Butterfly to Single-Leg X
description: Elevate the trapped leg, scoot the hips underneath, wrap the outside leg around the waist, and connect straight ashi.

name: Deep Half Guard Control
description: Place the body beneath the opponent's center, carry the near leg on the shoulder, protect the arms, and keep the head from being crossfaced.

name: Homer Simpson Sweep
description: Walk the legs toward the trapped side, keep the near leg captured, and roll the opponent over the blocked base into top.

name: Deep-Half Waiter Sweep
description: Elevate the captured leg onto the shoulder, rotate beneath the hips, block the far base, and follow the tilt to top.

name: Deep-Half Backdoor Sweep
description: Turn under the carried leg, emerge behind the hips, control the far knee, and drive forward into rear top position.

name: Deep Half to X Guard
description: Lift the carried leg, thread the far foot to the opposite hip, place the lower hook behind the knee, and extend into X guard.

name: Lockdown Half Guard
description: Triangle the trapped leg with an instep hook, extend to manage distance, and keep the knees aligned without twisting the partner's knee.

name: Lockdown Whip-Up
description: Extend the lockdown, rock the opponent forward, swim double underhooks, and move onto a side beneath the hips.

name: Electric Chair Sweep
description: From double underhooks, underhook the far leg, extend the lockdown, turn the knees, and come up while respecting hip flexibility.

name: Lockdown to Dogfight Sweep
description: Use the whip-up to win an underhook, come to the knees, release the entanglement at the right moment, and finish a knee tap.

name: Octopus Half Guard Control
description: Sit up around the opponent's far waist from a reverse-underhook angle, hide the near arm, and keep the trapped leg connected.

name: Octopus Guard Hip-Bump Sweep
description: Clamp the far waist, post behind, lift the hips into the opponent's base, and rotate toward the trapped arm side.

name: Octopus Guard Back Take
description: Pull the far waist forward, scoot behind the near shoulder, free the bottom knee, and connect chest-to-back.

name: Half Guard to Closed Guard
description: Frame the shoulders, create hip space, thread the trapped knee free, and reconnect both legs around the waist.

name: Half Guard to Butterfly Guard
description: Use elbow-knee connection to insert the inside foot as a hook, square the hips, and build seated upper-body control.

name: Closed-Guard Top Posture
description: Align head over hips, keep elbows inside, control the torso or hips, and deny angles before opening the legs.

name: Knee-in-Tailbone Guard Break
description: Build a staggered base, control the torso, place the knee behind the hips, and move backward until the ankles separate.

name: Standing Closed-Guard Break
description: Control an arm and torso, stand one foot at a time with posture, shift the hips back, and press a knee line to open.

name: Elbow-to-Knee Closed-Guard Break
description: Keep elbows tight, angle the hips, wedge one elbow near the inner knee, and create separation without digging into soft tissue.

name: São Paulo Pass
description: Turn the hips, pin one side of the guard with shoulder and elbow position, walk the trapped knee free, and settle chest-to-chest.

name: Standing Guard Break to Knee Cut
description: Open the ankles from standing, staple one shin, enter headquarters, and slice the knee across while winning upper-body control.

name: Standing Guard Break to Double-Under Pass
description: After opening, scoop both thighs, bring the knees toward the chest, angle to one side, and pass without loading the neck.

name: Double-Under Pass
description: Scoop beneath both thighs, connect hands low, lift the hips, angle the knees toward one shoulder, and circle past the legs.

name: Single-Under Stack Pass
description: Underhook one leg, pin the opposite thigh, stack on the hips rather than neck, and walk around the underhooked side.

name: Over-Under Pass
description: Overhook one thigh, underhook the other, lock the hips, walk toward the overhook side, and clear the knees before settling.

name: Toreando Pass
description: Control shins or pants, redirect both knees aside, step around the hip line, and connect chest-to-chest before the guard recovers.

name: Toreando to Knee-on-Belly
description: After clearing the knees, pin the far hip and shoulder, place the shin across the belt line, and keep the trailing foot active.

name: Side-to-Side Toreando Passing
description: Redirect the legs one way, switch grips as the guard follows, and accelerate around the opposite hip when the feet cross center.

name: X Pass
description: Pin the lead shin, step the free leg back and across, clear the knee line, and cover the hip before turning in.

name: Knee-Cut Pass
description: Control the near knee, win underhook or shoulder position, point the slicing knee across the thigh, and free the trailing foot.

name: Underhook Knee-Cut Pass
description: Use an underhook and crossface to turn the shoulders away, staple the near leg, slice the knee, and clear the ankle.

name: Knee-Cut to Long-Step Chain
description: Threaten the knee cut, switch the hips as the knee shield follows, extend the trapped leg back, and circle around the far hip.

name: Leg-Drag Pass
description: Direct both knees across the body, trap the lower thigh at the hip, connect chest to the far hip, and climb to upper-body control.

name: Leg Drag to Back Take
description: Keep the knees pointed away, control the far hip, move behind the shoulder line, and insert the near hook as the opponent turns.

name: Tripod Pass
description: Use head-and-arm or chest pressure while the hips stay high, pin one knee, walk the feet around, and settle after clearing the legs.

name: Headquarters Passing Position
description: Pin one shin between the legs, keep a staggered base, control the near knee and upper body, and deny inside hooks.

name: Headquarters Knee Cut
description: From a stable split stance, win the upper body, staple the near shin, and slice across while freeing the rear foot.

name: Headquarters Smash Pass
description: Fold the knees together, switch the hips toward the feet, pin both thighs, and walk around the compacted guard.

name: Headquarters Backstep Pass
description: Control the near knee, backstep the free leg behind the hips, turn chest toward the legs, and free the trapped knee line.

name: Body-Lock Pass
description: Connect the hands below the ribs, pin the hips, walk the knees to one side, clear the hooks, and climb to chest-to-chest control.

name: Body-Lock Pass with Knee Block
description: Keep the waist lock, use one knee to block the near thigh, circle the far leg free, and settle the hips past the knee line.

name: Body-Lock Pass to Half-Guard Finish
description: Accept a controlled half guard, win crossface and underhook, flatten the hips, and free the trapped foot methodically.

name: Float Pass
description: Post weight through hands or upper body, keep the hips light above the hooks, pummel the feet, and land beyond the knee line.

name: Float-Pass Backstep
description: As the guard turns under, keep weight centered, backstep outside the hip, clear the knee line, and face the legs before settling.

name: Folding Pass
description: Push both knees toward one shoulder, connect chest to thighs, pin the hips, and walk around without compressing the neck.

name: Leg-Weave Pass
description: Thread an arm between the knees, clamp the top thigh to the bottom leg, sprawl the hips, and circle around the shield.

name: Smash Pass
description: Fold both knees to one side, switch the hips toward the feet, pin the thighs, and climb from hip control to chest control.

name: Long-Step Pass
description: Control the near knee and upper body, switch the hips, extend the trapped leg far behind, and circle chest-first around the shield.

name: Dope-Mount Pass
description: When the knees turn across, step or slide the far knee over the legs, pin the hips, and settle directly into mount.

name: Cartwheel Pass
description: Control head or shoulders, post safely, arc the legs beyond the guard, and land balanced with chest-to-back or side-control connection.

name: Throw-By Pass
description: Control head and arm, shuck the shoulders across, circle behind the elbows, and connect to the hips before the guard turns.

name: Front-Headlock Go-Behind Pass
description: Snap the seated opponent to hands, block the near arm, circle behind the shoulders, and secure the waist before hooks recover.

name: Shin-Pin Pass
description: Pin one shin with hand and foot or knee, control the far knee, step around the hip, and cover the upper body.

name: High-Step Pass
description: Control the near leg, lift the knee high over the feet, step beyond the hip line, and turn in before the guard reconnects.

name: North–South Passing Route
description: Redirect both knees, keep hip control, circle toward the head beyond the frames, and settle chest over the shoulders.

name: Outside Passing Chain
description: Switch among shin control, X pass, toreando, and leg drag as the knees track, attacking the side that loses frames.

name: Inside Passing Chain
description: Use headquarters to alternate knee cut, smash, backstep, and long-step responses while preserving upper-body control.

name: Half-Guard Crossface and Underhook
description: Turn the face away with shoulder pressure, win the far underhook, flatten the hips, and keep the trapped knee pointed safely.

name: Half-Guard Knee-Slice Pass
description: Use crossface and underhook, walk the trapped knee above the opponent's knee, slice across, and free the ankle.

name: Half-Guard Tripod Pass
description: Raise the hips while keeping shoulder pressure, walk the trapped foot toward the opening, windshield-wiper the knee, and settle back down.

name: Half-Guard Knee-Then-Ankle Escape
description: First clear the knee line using hip pressure, then pin the thigh and pummel or pry the ankle free without rushing.

name: Half-Guard Backstep Pass
description: Control the near knee and upper body, backstep behind the hips, face the trapped legs, and free the knee line before turning back in.

name: Reverse Half-Guard Pass
description: Turn the hips toward the legs, control the bottom knee and far hip, walk the trapped leg free, and rotate into side control.

name: Knee-Shield Smash Pass
description: Collapse the shield toward the bottom leg, switch the hips, pin both knees, and climb to chest-to-chest half guard.

name: Knee-Shield Leg-Weave Pass
description: Thread the arm between the knees, grip or clamp the lower leg, sprawl the top hip, and circle around the shield.

name: Knee-Shield Over-Under Pass
description: Overhook the top leg, underhook the lower thigh, turn the knees away, and walk around while controlling the hips.

name: Near-Side Underhook Half-Guard Pass
description: Use a near-side underhook and hip switch to pin the bottom shoulder, expose the knee line, and walk the trapped leg free.

name: Lockdown Free-Foot Pass
description: Bring the trapped heel close, peel the instep connection with the free foot, regain knee position, and resume chest-to-chest passing.

name: Crossface–Underhook Side Control
description: Control the far shoulder with an underhook, turn the face away with shoulder pressure, block the near hip, and keep knees mobile.

name: Far-Hip Block Side Control
description: Place a hand, elbow, or knee at the far hip while controlling the shoulders so the bottom player cannot freely insert knees.

name: Kesa Gatame Control
description: Control the head and near arm, spread the legs for base, keep the ribs heavy, and monitor space behind the back.

name: Modified Kesa Gatame
description: Use the far underhook instead of trapping the near arm, keep hip and rib pressure, and maintain a wide mobile base.

name: Reverse Kesa Gatame
description: Face the legs, block the near hip, control the far arm or thigh, and keep weight over the torso while preparing mount.

name: Side Control to Knee-on-Belly
description: Control far shoulder and hip, post up without leaning, slide the near shin across the belt line, and keep the trailing foot live.

name: Side Control to Mount
description: Block the far hip, walk the near knee high across the belly, windshield-wiper the foot, and settle knees beneath the armpits.

name: Side Control to North–South
description: Control both shoulders or hips, walk around the head beyond the frames, and settle chest over the upper torso before switching sides.

name: Near-Side Armbar from Side Control
description: Pin the near wrist, step the head-side leg over, sit close to the shoulder, clamp the knees, and control the thumb line.

name: Far-Side Armbar from Side Control
description: Isolate the far arm with an underhook, post at the hip, pivot around the head, and sit tight to the captured shoulder.

name: Americana from Side Control
description: Pin the wrist near the mat, connect a figure-four, keep the elbow near shoulder level, and rotate the forearm under control.

name: Kimura from Side Control
description: Control the far wrist, connect the figure-four, pin the shoulder, and bring the hand behind the back without lifting the elbow wildly.

name: Straight Armbar from Side Control
description: Trap the arm between neck and shoulder or both forearms, control the wrist, and extend the elbow against a stable fulcrum.

name: Arm-Triangle from Side Control
description: Drive the far arm across the neck, connect head and arm, walk toward the trapped side, and compress with chest pressure.

name: Paper-Cutter Choke
description: Control the far collar under the head, place the near forearm across the neck, keep the elbow low, and pull the collar while driving the forearm.

name: Baseball-Bat Choke from Side Control
description: Set palm-up and palm-down collar grips close together, circle toward north–south, and bring the elbows together around the neck.

name: Brabo Choke from Side Control
description: Feed the opponent's lapel beneath the far arm, pass it to the choking hand, sprawl the shoulder, and walk toward the head.

name: D'Arce Choke from Side Control
description: Thread the arm beneath the near armpit and neck, connect biceps-and-hand grip, sprawl the chest, and angle toward the trapped arm.

name: Kimura-Trap Back Take from Side Control
description: Maintain the figure-four as the opponent turns, move behind the shoulders, step over the torso, and insert hooks or a seatbelt.

name: Gift-Wrap Control from Side Control
description: Feed the far wrist behind the head, control it with the underhooking hand, and keep the near shoulder pinned for mount or back exposure.

name: Wrist Lock from Side Control
description: Immobilize the elbow and forearm, fold the hand only within a controlled range, and apply gradual pressure while monitoring the tap.

name: Kesa Gatame Armbar
description: Trap the near arm between the legs or hips, control the wrist, isolate the elbow, and extend against the thigh fulcrum.

name: Kesa Gatame Chest Compression
description: Control head and arm, expand the chest while drawing the elbow inward, and apply steady rib-and-diaphragm compression without sudden force.

name: Buggy Choke from Bottom Side Control
description: Thread the near arm and leg around the opponent's neck and shoulder, connect the lock, angle the hips, and compress while protecting the knee.

name: Side-Control Back Take
description: Use gift-wrap or far-arm control to turn the opponent, insert the near knee behind the back, sit to the hip, and secure hooks.

name: Frame-and-Hip-Escape from Side Control
description: Frame at neck and hip, bridge to create lightness, move the hips away, insert the near knee, and recover guard.

name: Underhook Escape to Knees
description: Win the near-side underhook, turn onto a side, build to elbow and knee, and come up behind the far leg while protecting the neck.

name: Bridge-and-Roll Side-Control Escape
description: Block the far post, bridge the opponent above the shoulders, turn toward the trapped arm, and follow through to top.

name: Ghost Escape
description: Frame the near arm, bridge to create space, slide the head and shoulders beneath the armpit, and spin to knees or front headlock.

name: Running-Man Escape
description: Turn to the side with elbows tight, frame the hip, walk the legs away, and use the shell to recover turtle or guard.

name: Elbow-Push Side-Control Escape
description: Frame the near triceps, bridge and turn to create an elbow gap, push the arm across, and sit up or recover guard.

name: High-Leg Re-Guard from Side Control
description: Frame the upper body, create shoulder space, swing the near leg high over the shoulder line, and replace a knee shield.

name: Side Control to Turtle Escape
description: Frame enough space to turn toward the knees, keep elbows tight, protect the neck, and establish a stable turtle before recovering.

name: Kesa Gatame Bridge-and-Turn Escape
description: Walk close, trap the near base, bridge the opponent over the head-side shoulder, and rotate to top without exposing the arm.

name: Kesa Gatame Back-Take Escape
description: Frame at the hip, move the hips away, free the near elbow, and circle behind as the top player follows the head.

name: Reverse Kesa to Half-Guard Recovery
description: Frame the near hip, bring the outside knee inside, capture the lower leg, and turn onto a side with a knee shield.

name: Side-Control Single-Leg Escape
description: Frame the far shoulder, sit up as pressure shifts, capture the near leg, and rise with the head inside to a single.

name: Side Control to North–South Turn Escape
description: Track the passer with forearm frames, turn the shoulders with the hips, and insert an elbow or knee before they settle north–south.

name: North–South Control
description: Spread weight over the shoulders, control elbows or hips, keep the head low, and move with the bottom player's turning direction.

name: North–South Choke
description: Wrap the neck with the armpit, keep the choking arm flat, walk the hips away, and lower the ribs until the neck space closes.

name: Kimura from North–South
description: Pin one wrist, connect the figure-four, keep the shoulder near the mat, and turn the hand behind the back under control.

name: Armbar from North–South
description: Isolate an arm, step around the head, sit close to the shoulder, clamp both knees, and control the wrist line.

name: North–South to Back Take
description: As the opponent turns to a side or knees, control the near arm, circle behind the shoulders, and connect a seatbelt before inserting hooks.

name: North–South to Mount
description: Control both elbows, walk one knee past the near shoulder, rotate around the hip line, and settle into high mount.

name: North–South Pendulum Escape
description: Swing the legs to create momentum, turn the shoulders toward one side, frame the hip, and recover guard or turtle.

name: North–South Elbow-Frame Escape
description: Place forearms inside the hips or shoulders, walk the body away, turn onto a side, and insert a knee between bodies.

name: North–South Inversion Escape
description: Frame at the hips, roll across the shoulders without loading the neck, thread the knees inside, and return to open guard.

name: Low Mount Control
description: Keep knees pinched near the hips, use grapevines or feet wide for base, control the head, and float with bridge attempts.

name: High Mount Control
description: Walk the knees beneath the armpits, keep hips heavy over the chest, isolate elbows above the shoulder line, and maintain a wide base.

name: S-Mount Control
description: Turn one knee behind the shoulder and the other foot near the far armpit, pinch the upper body, and keep weight off the ribs.

name: Technical Mount Control
description: When the opponent turns, wedge one knee behind the back, place the other foot near the hip, and control the upper shoulder and wrist.

name: Mount Crossface and Elbow Isolation
description: Crossface to turn the head, walk the opposite elbow above the shoulder, and climb the knees while staying balanced.

name: Americana from Mount
description: Pin the wrist, connect a figure-four, keep the elbow near shoulder height, and rotate the forearm toward the mat gradually.

name: Straight Armbar from Mount
description: Trap the arm against the neck or chest, control the wrist and elbow, and extend the elbow over a stable forearm fulcrum.

name: Arm-Triangle from Mount
description: Drive one arm across the neck, connect head and arm, lower the head-side hip, and dismount to the trapped-arm side to finish.

name: Armbar from Mount
description: Isolate an arm above the shoulder, rotate to S-mount, control the head, step the leg over, and sit close before extending.

name: Mounted Triangle
description: Push one arm between the legs, step the opposite leg over the neck, lock the triangle, and adjust angle without losing top control.

name: Mounted Triangle Armbar
description: With the triangle locked, secure the trapped wrist, pinch the knees, and extend the arm against the thigh while preserving the choke.

name: Cross-Collar Choke from Mount
description: Set the first hand deep at the label, base during the bridge, cross the second grip, and draw elbows toward the torso.

name: Ezekiel Choke from Mount
description: Grip inside one sleeve behind the neck, bring the free forearm across the throat line, and compress while maintaining base.

name: No-Gi Ezekiel from Mount
description: Thread one arm behind the neck, connect the hands, place the opposite forearm across the throat, and compress gradually.

name: Mounted Guillotine
description: Capture the neck during a turn, connect the hands, keep the choking elbow aligned, and use mount to prevent rolling escape.

name: Chest-Compression Choke from Mount
description: Control both arms or head position, lower the chest over the mouth-and-nose line only within agreed rules, and apply measured pressure.

name: Gift-Wrap Control from Mount
description: Feed the far wrist behind the head, control it with the underhooking hand, and use the trapped shoulder to turn the opponent.

name: Gift-Wrap Back Take from Mount
description: Use the gift wrap to turn the shoulders, wedge the near knee behind the back, sit to the hip, and pull the opponent into hooks.

name: Armbar from Technical Mount
description: Control the upper arm and head, step the hip-side leg over the face, sit close to the shoulder, and clamp the knees.

name: Bow-and-Arrow Choke from Technical Mount
description: Feed a deep collar grip, control the far hip or pant, sit behind the shoulder, and extend the legs while drawing the collar.

name: Wrist Lock from Mount
description: Pin the elbow and forearm against the mat or torso, fold the hand gradually, and stop immediately on the tap.

name: Mount to S-Mount Transition
description: Isolate one elbow high, shift weight to the opposite knee, rotate the near knee behind the shoulder, and bring the far foot forward.

name: Floating Mount Control
description: Post through hands or head-and-arm control, let the knees become light during kips, and re-land above the hips as the legs extend.

name: Mount Backstep to Side Control
description: When the bottom player traps a leg deeply, backstep the free leg, turn toward the trapped knees, and settle into side control or reverse half.

name: Trap-and-Roll Mount Escape
description: Trap one arm and same-side foot, bridge the hips above the shoulder, turn toward the trapped side, and establish top posture.

name: Elbow–Knee Mount Escape
description: Frame at the hips, turn slightly, move the hips away, wedge one knee inside, and recover half or full guard.

name: Kipping Mount Escape
description: Frame at the hips with elbows inside, alternate short bridges, create knee space, and insert both knees into ashi or butterfly guard.

name: Heel-Drag Mount Escape
description: Turn to a side, use the outside foot to drag the opponent's ankle over the trapped leg, and secure half guard.

name: Bridge to Single-Leg X from Mount
description: Frame the hips, bridge to lighten one knee, thread both legs beneath that side, and connect straight ashi before extending away.

name: Butterfly-Guard Recovery from Mount
description: Frame the hips, create space with repeated bridges, insert one then both insteps inside the thighs, and square into butterfly guard.

name: Underhook Escape from Mount to Half Guard
description: Turn onto a side, win an underhook, frame the hip, slide the bottom knee underneath, and come up into half-guard dogfight.

name: Backdoor Mount Escape
description: When the knees climb high, frame the hips, scoot beneath one thigh, rotate under the leg, and emerge to guard or top position.

name: Mount Hand-Fighting Survival
description: Keep elbows below the shoulder line, protect the neck, use two-on-one grips, and bridge before moving the arms back inside.

name: Technical-Mount Shoulder-to-Mat Escape
description: Control the choking arm, bring the upper shoulder to the mat, frame the knee behind the back, and turn in to half guard.

name: Technical-Mount Hip Escape
description: Frame the hip-side knee, scoot the hips toward the feet, clear the back wedge, and recover half guard without exposing the neck.

name: Mount Escape Chain
description: Use the bridge to force posts, switch to elbow-knee space when the base widens, and kip only when the hands and knees align.

name: Mounted Triangle Escape
description: Protect the trapped arm, frame the opponent's hips, turn toward the open side, and create knee-line space before posture is lost.

name: Seatbelt Back Control
description: Place the choking arm over one shoulder and control hand under the other, keep chest attached, and hide the top hand.

name: Double-Hooks Back Control
description: Insert both insteps inside the thighs without crossing the feet, connect the seatbelt, and follow shoulder and hip rotation.

name: Body-Triangle Back Control
description: Triangle the legs around the torso with the lock away from the floor, keep the knee line safe, and use the seatbelt to control rotation.

name: Chair-Sit Back-Take Finish
description: Control seatbelt and near hip, sit to the controlled side, pull the opponent onto the lap, and insert the bottom hook first.

name: Hip-Scoop Back Recovery
description: When the opponent slides low, post behind, scoop the far hip back onto the lap, and reconnect the knee and shoulder lines.

name: Rear Naked Choke
description: Slide the forearm beneath the chin, connect biceps and hand behind the head, hide the elbows, and expand the chest while drawing shoulders back.

name: Short Choke
description: Place the forearm under the chin, connect palm-to-palm or wrist control, pin the head, and close the elbow with measured pressure.

name: Rear Naked Choke with Hand Trap
description: Use a leg to trap one defensive arm, control the other wrist two-on-one, and feed the choking hand beneath the chin.

name: Straightjacket Back Control
description: Control opposite wrists across the torso, trap one arm with a leg, and maintain chest-to-back alignment while opening the neck.

name: Rear Triangle Choke
description: Thread one leg over the shoulder and neck from behind, lock behind the knee, control the trapped arm, and angle the hips.

name: Rear-Triangle Armbar
description: With the rear triangle controlling the shoulders, isolate the trapped arm, pinch the knees, and extend the elbow against the thigh.

name: Armbar from Back Control
description: Control one arm two-on-one, bring the top leg over the head, pivot the hips beside the shoulder, and clamp the elbow line.

name: Trap Triangle from Back Control
description: Trap one arm with the leg, thread the other leg over the neck, lock the triangle from the side or rear, and finish with hip angle.

name: Bow-and-Arrow Choke
description: Set a deep cross-collar grip, control the far leg or hip, angle behind the shoulder, and extend the body while drawing the collar.

name: Sliding-Collar Choke from Back
description: Feed one hand deep along the collar, control the opposite lapel or shoulder, align the forearm under the chin, and draw both grips apart.

name: Clock-Style Collar Choke from Back
description: Maintain a deep collar grip as the opponent turns down, control the far hip, and walk the body around the head to tighten the collar.

name: Ezekiel Choke from Back Control
description: Grip inside the opposite sleeve, place the free forearm across the front of the neck, and compress while keeping the chest attached.

name: Wrist Lock from Back Control
description: Immobilize one elbow with chest or leg control, fold the captured hand gradually, and keep the partner's shoulder safe.

name: Back Control to Mount
description: When the opponent brings shoulders to the mat, keep upper-body control, step the top leg across the torso, and settle into mount.

name: Rear Body-Lock Ride
description: Lock around the waist, keep knees behind the hips, follow stand-ups, and return the opponent safely without crossing into unsafe slams.

name: Power Half-Nelson Back Control
description: Thread a half nelson, reinforce the wrist or forearm, drive the shoulder toward the mat, and use it to expose the back without cranking the neck.

name: Twister from Back Control
description: Control one leg with a lockdown-style entanglement, isolate the far arm, secure head-and-arm control, and rotate only under expert supervision.

name: Back-Control Hand Fighting
description: Protect the neck first, use two hands on the choking arm, keep chin and shoulders organized, and identify the underhook side.

name: Safe-Side Back Escape
description: Win the hand fight, bring the choking-side shoulder toward the mat, remove the bottom hook, slide the hips down, and turn in.

name: Shoulder-to-Mat Back Escape
description: Control the choking arm, walk the head and shoulders to the mat, keep the neck safe, and turn toward the opponent's legs.

name: Hook-Peel Back Escape
description: Pin or peel the bottom hook with a foot, slide the hips below it, bring the shoulder to the mat, and turn to guard.

name: Body-Triangle Lock-Side Escape
description: Turn so the lock approaches the mat, protect the choking arm, use the floor and hip movement to open the figure-four, and clear the knee line.

name: Body-Triangle Hip-Slide Escape
description: Hand-fight, scoot the hips below the opponent's knees, bring a shoulder to the mat, and turn inside as the triangle loosens.

name: Back Escape by Turning into Guard
description: After clearing the bottom hook and bringing the shoulder to the mat, frame the hips, turn inside, and establish top half or guard.

name: Wall-Scrape Back Escape
description: Protect the neck, use a legal boundary or training wall only when allowed, scrape one shoulder down, and turn inside as hooks loosen.

name: Stand-Up Escape from Rear Body Lock
description: Fight the hands, widen the base, peel the lock, turn an elbow inside, and face the opponent without exposing the neck.

name: Granby Escape from Rear Ride
description: Control the near arm, roll across the shoulder rather than neck, rotate the hips through, and recover guard or a neutral scramble.

name: Early Rear-Naked-Choke Defense
description: Turn the chin toward the elbow crease, use both hands to pull the choking wrist down, and move the shoulder toward the mat before the grip locks.

name: Late Rear-Naked-Choke Hand Fight
description: Immediately control the choking forearm with both hands, create a breathing line if possible, and tap early if the lock is complete.

name: Bow-and-Arrow Choke Escape
description: Use two hands to strip or slacken the choking collar, turn toward the grip, free the leg control, and bring shoulders to the mat.

name: Seatbelt Control from Turtle
description: Place one arm over and one under the shoulders, keep knees behind the hips, and follow the elbows without falling over the top.

name: Tight-Waist Turtle Ride
description: Wrap the waist, keep chest over the hips, block a near arm or ankle, and follow hip movement without reaching above the shoulders.

name: Spiral Ride
description: Thread one arm inside the thigh and the other near the upper arm, stretch the base diagonally, and expose a hip for hooks.

name: Claw Ride
description: Wrap the far lat or chest from behind, control the near hip, pull the shoulders toward the hip, and maintain a rear angle.

name: Wrist Ride
description: Control a wrist behind or across the waist, pin the near hip, and use the trapped arm to flatten or expose the back.

name: Ankle Ride
description: Hook or control the near ankle while maintaining a tight waist, collapse the base, and insert a hook as the hip opens.

name: Arm-Chop Turtle Breakdown
description: Control waist and near arm, chop the elbow inward, drive the far shoulder forward, and settle behind the exposed hip.

name: Spiral-Ride Breakdown
description: Use the thigh spiral and upper-arm control to stretch opposite corners, flatten one hip, and climb into chest-to-back control.

name: Chair-Sit Back Take from Turtle
description: Secure the seatbelt, place the near knee behind the hip, sit to that side, pull the opponent onto the lap, and insert hooks.

name: Near-Hook Back Take from Turtle
description: Open the near hip with a knee or ankle ride, insert the bottom hook, keep the seatbelt, and roll to the controlled side.

name: Far-Knee-Block Back Take
description: Block the far knee, pull the seatbelt across the near shoulder, turn the hips into a seated position, and insert the first hook.

name: Clock Choke
description: Feed a deep collar grip, control the far wrist or hip, drop weight beside the head, and walk the feet around the clock.

name: Rolling Clock Choke
description: Keep a deep collar grip, control the far side, roll across the shoulders beside the opponent, and use the rotation to tighten the collar.

name: Crucifix from Turtle
description: Trap the near arm between the legs, control the far arm with the upper body, and sit or roll to isolate both shoulders.

name: Rear Naked Choke from Crucifix
description: Keep one arm trapped with the legs and the other controlled, slide the forearm under the chin, and finish with chest expansion.

name: Armbar from Crucifix
description: Pin one arm with the legs, control the wrist, trap the elbow against the thigh or hip, and extend gradually.

name: Front-Headlock Chin-Strap Control
description: Cup the chin with the elbow tight, control the near arm, sprawl the hips away, and keep the chest over the shoulders.

name: Guillotine from Front Headlock
description: Bring the choking wrist beneath the chin, connect the hands, close the elbow over the shoulder, and sit to controlled guard or finish on top.

name: D'Arce Choke from Front Headlock
description: Thread the arm under the near armpit and neck, connect biceps-and-hand grip, sprawl, and angle toward the trapped arm.

name: Anaconda Choke
description: Thread around neck and far arm, connect biceps-and-hand grip, roll toward the trapped side, and walk the hips in to compress.

name: Peruvian Necktie
description: Control neck and near arm, sit beside the shoulder, place a leg over the upper back, and extend while drawing the grip inward.

name: Defensive Turtle Structure
description: Keep elbows and knees close, forehead off the mat, neck protected, and hips ready to move rather than staying flattened.

name: Turtle Hand Fighting
description: Protect the neck, peel the overhooking arm two-on-one, keep elbows inside, and create a side for the next escape.

name: Turtle Sit-Out Escape
description: Control the near arm, step the far foot outside, sit the hips through, turn to face, and recover guard or front headlock.

name: Turtle Peek-Out
description: Post one hand, step the opposite foot outside, drive the head through the arm gap, and circle behind the opponent.

name: Standing Switch from Turtle
description: Control the near wrist, sit the hips out, reach around the far hip, and rotate behind while keeping the neck protected.

name: Stand-Up from Turtle
description: Hand-fight the waist lock, build to one foot then both, keep a wide base, and turn inside once the hands separate.

name: Quadpod Hip-Heist Escape
description: Raise the hips into a four-point base, control the hands, step one leg outside, and hip-heist to face or stand.

name: Turtle Roll to Guard
description: Protect one shoulder and the neck, roll toward the open side, thread the knees between bodies, and finish facing the opponent.

name: Turtle Pull to Half Guard
description: Control the near arm, sit to the hip, capture the opponent's lower leg, and turn inward with frames and a knee shield.

name: Turtle Single-Leg Counter
description: Catch the near leg during a ride, turn the head inside, build to a knee, and finish as a single-leg without exposing the neck.

name: Granby to Wrestle-Up
description: Roll across the near shoulder to clear the ride, catch a leg as the opponent follows, and rise into a single-leg finish.

name: Kimura Counter from Turtle
description: Capture the overhooking wrist, connect a figure-four, sit to a hip, and use the grip to sweep, turn, or recover guard.

name: Butterfly Ashi Control
description: Wrap the near leg with the inside foot under the far thigh, pinch the knees, control the ankle, and keep both feet protected.

name: Outside Ashi Control
description: Place both legs outside the captured hip, clamp the thigh, control the knee line, and avoid exposing crossed feet.

name: Cross Ashi / Saddle Control
description: Triangle the legs around one thigh with inside position, control the secondary leg, and keep knees pinched while protecting your own feet.

name: False-Reap Entry
description: From an outside knee frame, thread the far leg across the hip without locking an illegal reap, rotate beneath the knee, and enter backside control.

name: Reverse X to Saddle
description: Use reverse-X hooks to turn the far knee inward, rotate beneath the hips, and close the inside triangle around the captured thigh.

name: Straight Ankle Lock from Single-Leg X
description: Place the wrist blade beneath the Achilles, control the knee line, hide the elbow, extend the hips, and arch without twisting the knee.

name: Straight Ankle Lock from Butterfly Ashi
description: Use the inside foot to control the far thigh, clamp the near knee, place the wrist beneath the Achilles, and extend through the hips.

name: Shotgun Ankle Lock
description: Control the foot with both hands against the torso, pinch the captured knee, extend the legs, and fold the ankle line gradually.

name: Belly-Down Straight Ankle Lock
description: Maintain the Achilles grip while turning to the knees, keep the captured knee between your thighs, and extend the hips toward the mat.

name: Aoki Lock
description: Control the knee line and turn the foot so the heel is displaced inward, then apply gradual hip extension; treat it as a rotational lock.

name: Estima Lock
description: Trap the foot against the torso with the toes folded, control the knee, rotate the body over the foot, and apply pressure slowly.
setup_from: De La Riva or inversion counter

name: Outside Heel Hook from Outside Ashi
description: Expose the heel with wrist control, immobilize the knee line, connect the hands, and rotate the torso minimally until the tap.

name: Inside Heel Hook from Saddle
description: From cross ashi, expose the inside heel, keep the knee captured, connect the grip, and rotate with the whole torso under strict control.

name: Heel Hook from Backside 50/50
description: Control the opponent's knee from behind the hip, expose the heel, prevent hip rotation, and finish with a small controlled torso turn.

name: Heel Hook from 50/50
description: Win the heel and knee-line battle, control the secondary leg, connect the heel grip, and rotate only after the opponent's hip is immobilized.

name: Kneebar from Saddle
aliases: Straight knee bar from cross ashi
description: Switch the knee line across the hips, pinch above the kneecap, control the heel, and extend the hips in line with the knee.

name: Kneebar from Top Half Guard
description: Control the lower leg, backstep around the trapped knee, pinch the thigh, sit beside the hip, and extend the captured knee line.

name: Kneebar from Bottom Half Guard
description: Underhook the far leg, rotate beneath the hips, clamp above the knee, control the heel, and align the hips with the joint.

name: Toe Hold from Ashi Garami
description: Control the toes with one hand and the wrist with the other, stabilize the knee line, and rotate the foot gradually toward the hip.

name: Toe Hold from Top Half Guard
description: Expose the trapped foot, connect a figure-four around the toes and ankle, control the knee, and rotate with measured pressure.

name: Calf Slicer from Half Guard
description: Place the shin as a fulcrum behind the knee, trap the foot, close the knee angle, and apply compression slowly.

name: Calf Slicer from the Truck
description: Control one leg in a figure-four ride, place the shin behind the knee, trap the foot, and close the leg angle gradually.

name: Biceps Slicer from Armbar Control
description: Place the shin or forearm as a fulcrum inside the elbow, trap the wrist, and close the arm angle slowly while protecting the joint.
